sampling.classification: Latest primary_sics_sector at or before 2023 from companies.csv
sampling.allocation: One per eligible SICS sector; remaining 30-S slots by Hamilton largest remainders weighted by eligible sector count minus one; alphabetical ties
sampling.eligibility: Known sector; at least one valid nonempty CSV metric in each source year 2015–2023 and at least one PDF with a valid header in each source year 2015–2022. Full PDF parsing is subsequently checked before acceptance. No task-specific metric, disclosure content or evaluator score gate.
sampling.missing_policy: No imputation of absent metrics or evidence strata; retain missingness. Failed PDF parsing is recorded; if an entire required source year is unusable, use the next prespecified same-sector reserve and record the replacement before any generation. Never replace on evaluator scores.

generation.length_policy: Accept first complete 300–500-word response; retry the identical prompt up to two times per invocation; preserve rejected text; never choose by evaluation score.

pilot.selection: One case per task, cycling sectors, companies and years in frozen order; selected before generation and evaluations.

source_quality.action: Exclude the entire card; preserve source PDF and raw extracted card cache; recheck source-year availability; no company replacement based on model scores.
